response.rationale: Four T1 meta-analyses (jeon-2016, nakanishi-2015, liu-2018, plus lee-2008 on enhancement) and several T3 studies (chang-2015, robb-1989, mason-1997) show that large amounts of easy, comprehensible input improve reading proficiency, vocabulary and comprehension, though much of the support is theory or practitioner material (T6) and the outcomes are mostly proficiency gains rather than direct predictions of comprehension from input comprehensibility, so confidence is held below very high.
